name: Alexia Asgari
title: Creative Technologist
bio: I am a creative technologist, with expertise in design and computation. I focus on building-scale innovation, interfacing with designers, engineers, and project managers, in my role as a Computational Model Engineer at Turner Construction. I'm currently in the final semester of my Master of Design Studies (Technology Track) at Harvard Graduate School of Design. My primary research interests include design, technology, arts, robotics, construction, digital fabrication, and cognition.
